findings.summary: Sweep and width detection is a fixed phrase list
findings.evidence: Phrases are matched as whole words, so 'wrapper' does not match 'wrap', but a sweep criterion worded another way (for example 'rename X throughout') gets no sweep hint. The impact is limited, because a wrong match only adds or leaves out one guidance sentence and gates nothing. D191's Tradeoff says so.

findings.summary: Each passing attempt's invocation detail duplicates the candidate's stored report
findings.evidence: The detail is a second copy of candidate.producer_report, which D191 itself says already held the check. The size cost is stated as an estimate of a few KB. I found no reader that treats a non-empty producer detail as a failure: the readers in verification.rs, introspect.rs and hestia.rs only use it when the outcome is not Success.

summary: The change does what the accepted reading asks. The producer brief, built in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, gains a section called "How the verifier checks each criterion" with one line per criterion. A content criterion is told to cite a named file or diff line. A behavior criterion is told to cite a command that ran. A sweep criterion ("every mention", "no longer appears") also gets a repo-wide search with zero remaining hits, and a rewrapped-prose criterion gets a line-width check. Criteria that only fmt, clippy or the full test suite can show are left to Athena's recorded checks. A passing producer attempt now also stores its redacted report, with each criterion's status and evidence, in its invocation detail. No refusal, send-back or hold rule is added. The passing path in producer.rs only sets that detail and then breaks as before. The root cause and the fix are written up in an appended decision, D191, which has a Provenance bullet, and in a CHANGELOG entry. Its claim that commit 81b1374e (2026-11-15) is later than all 43 introspections (the newest is 2026-11-03) matches history.json in the evidence snapshot. I ran the three new tests, the budgets tests and the mirrors tests, and all pass. Athena's records show fmt, clippy and test passing, and show the new tests failing (exit 101) with the fix reverted. Remaining issues are minor: send_back.rs changed although it is not on the deliverables list; producer.md and budgets.rs are on that list but unchanged; and the phrase matching is lexical.
